      • getProvidedPort

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nullable
IComponentPort getProvidedPort()
        Returns:
        The component port which has provided port role (maybe the required port if DelegationConnector).

        For delegation connectors the following logic is applied:

      • If the ports are p-ports: innerPort has the provided role, outerPort has the requested role.
      • If ports are r-ports: outerPort has the provided role, innerPort has the required role.

      • getRequiredPort

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nullable
IComponentPort getRequiredPort()
        Returns:
        The component port which has required port role (maybe the provided port if DelegationConnector).

        For delegation connectors the following logic is applied:

      • If ports are p-ports: innerPort has the provided role, outerPort has the required role.
      • If ports are r-ports: outerPort has the provided role, innerPort has the required role.
